bio.text: Jason Brodeur has represented District 10 in the Florida Senate since being elected in 2020, after serving in the Florida House of Representatives from 2010 to 2018.
Brodeur is a healthcare consultant and was a Seminole County Planning and Zoning Commissioner in 2006 and 2007.
Brodeur was born in Daytona Beach and holds a B.S. (1997) and an MBA (2003) from the University of Florida and a master of public health from Dartmouth College (2022).
